decisions.quote:
Here, we address the critique first by conducting a replication
       study using an independent sample of 9,300 subjects. This study replicates the gene-environment inter-
       action of the 5HTT gene variant with church attendance, but not the association with MAOA. We then
       focus on the general argument of the critique, showing that many of its characterizations of the literature
       in genetics and in political science are misleading or incorrect.
decisions.reason: Prior adjudication and state files do not yet exist for da46803ed980caec. Fowler and Dawes (2013, In Defense of Genopolitics) empirically re-tests only one original study: Fowler and Dawes (2008, Two Genes Predict Voter Turnout, DOI 10.1017/s0022381608080638), which is already paired and resolved in shipped row 207 (target_index 0). Shipped row 478 is an unpaired duplicate row that erroneously attaches Stein and Vonnahme (2008, Engaging the Unengaged Voter: Vote Centers and Voter Turnout, DOI 10.1017/s0022381608080456) to the same abstract quote. Stein and Vonnahme (2008) is never cited, mentioned, or tested anywhere in Fowler and Dawes (2013), and no second original study is re-tested (Charney and English 2012 is addressed as a critique rather than an empirical target). Dependent on the original decision to remove row 478, this row does not represent a replication or reproduction of Stein and Vonnahme (2008) or any second target.
